Open from 10am until late for hot drinks, beer, wine, cocktails and light bites. The Bar The Bistro Our suppliers. Our coffee comes from Iron & Fire Coffee Roasters (opens in a new tab) in Shrewsbury and our milk from Oakley Farm (opens in a new tab) just down the road. Budweiser Brewing Group (opens in a new tab) and Hobsons Brewery (opens in a new tab) helped us rebuild the bar and beer cellar with the latest technology. Our wines come from Everton's (opens in a new tab) of Worcester and Pattingham Vineyard (opens in a new tab) . Distilleries and suppliers from across the Midlands stock our spirit shelves and cocktail menu. There is a full range of soft drinks and no & low options too.
